{{recipe}} [[Category:Appetizer recipes]]

This is great as an appetizer for your next dinner party.

== Ingredients ==
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Cream Cheese|cream cheese]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Basil|basil]] [[Cookbook:Chiffonade|chiffonade]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]]
* 2 tbsp unsalted [[Cookbook:Butter|butter]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Salt|salt]]
* ½ tsp freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Pepper|black pepper]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Ricotta|ricotta cheese]]
* 30 cherry [[Cookbook:Tomato|tomatoes]], with the very top removed

== Procedure ==
#Combine all ingredients except tomatoes to make the filling.
#Place filling into a gallon-size zip-top bag with a small hole snipped in one of the bottom corners.
#Fill tomatoes about ¾ full.
#Serve chilled as an appetizer.
